AI code review results below, please doublecheck

The fix itself looks right: the premature list_del()/free_intf_descr() was the only path that let the shared failure block at the bottom of lustre_lnet_match_ip_to_intf() touch a freed descriptor, and dropping it leaves exactly one cleanup. Only commit-message and style points inline, plus one pre-existing observation in the same block - no need to re-spin for those alone, but the Fixes: tag is worth adding on the next refresh so the backport to the branches carrying LU-19444 can be tracked.

commit.subject: LU-20777 lnet: avoid double free for down ip2nets interface
commit.message:
LU-20777 lnet: avoid double free for down ip2nets interface

When processing an ip2nets rule, lustre_lnet_match_ip_to_intf()
frees the interface descriptor immediately if the matched interface
is not UP. This can result in a use-after-free and double free during
lnetctl import when an ip2nets rule refers to a down interface.

Leave the descriptor intact when detecting a down interface and let
the existing common failure path report the error and perform the
cleanup once.

Add a sanity-lnet test covering ip2nets import with a down interface.

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity-lnet

Change-Id: Ib6bc96427a7a251b86eb6eed409fb1f21ac42f6f
Signed-off-by: Serguei Smirnov <ssmirnov@thelustrecollective.com>
